lines.lyric_translation: I’m the first in my class baby, / I even got the rookie award

lines.lyric_hangul: 복도를 돌아다니다 보면 받아 새 후배들 인사도
lines.lyric_translation: Going around the halls, / I even get greeted by new juniors

lines.lyric_hangul: 이젠 좀 알 것 같애 리허설도 능숙하게
lines.lyric_translation: I think I know what’s going on now, / rehearsals going smoothly

lines.lyric_hangul: 1년 후배도 생기고 이젠 좀 나도 나가는 거 같애
lines.lyric_translation: I have juniors a year below me / and I think I’m doing well now

lines.lyric_hangul: Ah 쉿 어 근데 눈앞에 5, 6년차 선배들
lines.lyric_translation: Ahh, shit / but I see seniors five and six years above

lines.lyric_hangul: (안녕하세요) 그제야 느끼지 아직 멀기만 한 현재를
lines.lyric_translation: (Hello!) Now I realize, / I’m still far away

lines.lyric_hangul: 대중 선생님들은 작년까진 부담 안 줘
lines.lyric_translation: Teachers didn’t give / pressure last year

lines.lyric_hangul: 겨우 1학년 신인이라며 괜찮다며 나를 앉혀놓고
lines.lyric_translation: Saying that I’m just a rookie and that it’s okay / They sat me down and

lines.lyric_hangul: 세상이 얼마나 차가운지 몇 가지 과목으로 알려줬지
lines.lyric_translation: taught me how cold the world is / With a few subjects

lines.lyric_hangul: 선입견, 악플, 이중잣대, 욕설 그리고 무관심
lines.lyric_translation: Bias, negative comments, double standards, / smack talk and disinterest

lines.lyric: Seonsaengnim yeogido suneungi innayo
lines.lyric_hangul: 선생님 여기도 수능이 있나요
lines.lyric_translation: Teacher, do we have suneung for this too?

lines.lyric_hangul: 그런 것도 좋지만 음악이 하고 싶어요
lines.lyric_translation: That’s good too but I wanna do music
